The surplus is 686 rows, which is plausible for 30 customers with duplicated history (about 23 transactions each). The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. The transactions are all from January 2026, after both valid_from dates, so the current row applies to all of them. Filtering on is_current is therefore correct.
